about: Video 003 The Sirat: the shot list for Maryam 19:66-72 (the Taraweeh recording, 0-110.2 s): a new angle every 1.5-3 s; never the same shot type twice in a row; at most 3 foot close-ups, each under 2 s. Shared by the picture (engine/src/scenes/sirat/), the sound (engine/tools/mix_sirat.py) and QA. Times in seconds. type: the shot type; tpl: the template's frame (s) this beat follows (null: a new shot type). transitions: whip, smoke, flash (red lightning cut), flashHot (white-yellow fire flash), burn (fire-burn wipe), heart (heartbeat cut), smash (to black, <= 0.3 s), impact. occlude: moments the fire's light dips as if something passed in front of it (nothing is ever shown). heartRate: [from, to, bpm at from, bpm at to].

shots.why: 19:66 'when I have died, will I be brought forth alive?': the camera bursts out of smoke into the reveal: a blood-red boiling sky, the ocean of fire, the bridge one burning line across the pit; tiny silhouettes at the bottom
a slow, ominous drone flight along the burning line, sparks dripping into the pit
red lightning splits the black sky above the bridge
19:67 THE EDGE: a slow orbit around the faceless crowd on the cliff edge, the Traveller among them
low-angle close-up on his faceless head, trembling, lit from below; slow push-in
top-down drone (environment only): the bridge a thin line over the fire
'while he was nothing': his hands shaking, gripping nothing, ash landing on them
19:68 'gather them and the devils': smoke rolling over the pit; vague dark shadows move inside it (nothing more)
the crowd driven to the edge, seen from below the cliff's lip against the boiling sky
over his shoulder, out over the pit
the crowd dropping to their knees along the edge; others pushing past
tighter on his faceless head, a Dutch angle
'around Hell': over his shoulder as the flames below ERUPT
the eruption, wide: a crash zoom toward the column
from inside the flames, up at the burning line
heat haze and a storm of embers blow into the lens
THE STARE: chest-up, the camera circling slowly, ash falling
'upon their knees': the whole crowd kneeling along the edge of the pit, shadows in the smoke behind
19:69 'extract from every sect': giant thorned hooks rise out of the fire along the bridge; chains
figures shoved past the camera, out of focus; he stands frozen behind them
a hook rises through the line and drags a faceless figure off the bridge
red lightning tears across the sky over the hooks
the crossing begins: someone stumbles on the line; a hook's thorns scrape past him in sparks
'worst against the Most Merciful': a hook rises and passes right by the camera
the whole bridge from far away, a tiny lone figure on it, the fire ocean below
19:70: streaks of light race along the line (the crossing speeds)
flames surge up out of the pit under the bridge
still circling him, from the other side
'most worthy of burning therein': an abandoned prayer mat on the bridge catches fire
the crowd surges to the edge; he is pushed to the bridge's foot
19:71 THE CORE 'none of you except he will come to it': his bare foot steps off the rock onto the burning edge; stones crumble (foot close-up 1 of 3)
side profile: he walks along the bridge, the camera tracking alongside him
from behind him, looking ahead down the endless bridge into darkness
from below, through the flames: silhouettes crossing the line above
streaks of light fly past him on the line
a vertigo dolly-zoom down past his feet into the fire (foot close-up 2 of 3)
19:71 'an inevitability decreed': an hourglass on a rock at the edge, its last grains running out (cutaway)
'an inevitability decreed': his head bowed, breath shaking
ahead: one crawls, the last one is dragged
gold coins, a watch and a phone slip from a hand and melt as they fall
19:72 'We will save those who feared Allah': streaks of light race along the line to the far side
his feet over the white-hot fire, from under the bridge (foot close-up 3 of 3)
BREAKING: a tight push-in, the heartbeat pounding, a hook rising behind him
a smash to black (0.25 s)
'and leave the wrongdoers': a giant hook snaps across and snatches a faceless figure off the line (impact)
a smash to black (0.2 s)
THE FALL: the camera falls WITH him, spinning, into the blinding fire (a silhouette only)
the ending on the last phrase: a near-black ember frame, a fire glow pulsing: PART 1 / How fast will you cross?
the end card (2 s, inside the length): the logo and the credits on dark red
